description: Solve a discrete logarithm in a supplied subgroup of a prime field by prime-power digit lifting and CRT.

source.title: An improved algorithm for computing logarithms over GF(p) and its cryptographic significance

output.encoding: least x in [0,ord_p(g)) with g^x=h mod p, or -2 if h is outside the subgroup generated by g

contract.group_order: The primary factors p-1 and reduces it to the exact multiplicative order of g by repeatedly testing g^(order/q) mod p for each prime q
contract.prime_power_components: For each q^e dividing ord_p(g), the primary isolates successive base-q logarithm digits by removing the current partial power and raising to ord_p(g)/q^(j+1)
contract.digit_solver: Each digit is found by baby-step/giant-step in the order-q subgroup generated by g^(ord_p(g)/q)
contract.reconstruction: Prime-power logarithm residues are joined by the Chinese remainder theorem in increasing q order
contract.membership: h=0 or a failed prime-order digit search returns -2; g=1,h=1 returns 0
contract.independent_method: The reference enumerates powers of g directly and returns the first matching exponent
contract.distinction: Pohlig-Hellman factors the base order, lifts prime-power digits, and combines residues; this differs from a single BSGS search and from a shared-target direct table
contract.invalid_cases: Null or non-exact frame, p outside 3..1009, composite p, g outside 1..p-1, or h outside 0..p-1 returns -1

complexity.primary_time: O(sqrt(p) + sum(e_q*sqrt(q))) modular operations for trial factorization, order reduction, digit searches and CRT
